messages:
ana: posted a draft RFC for kernel muxing + attention gating + KV cache guardrails. link: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/2312345678 
ana: TL;DR: aim is to let runtime pick the fastest compatible kernel per request while keeping deterministic fallbacks and safe KV behavior for cold starts. Opt-in per-customer + model pinning for Dedicated. Asking for feedback on acceptance criteria and rollout plan by EOD Thur. :eyes:
matt: skimmed. high level looks good. a couple questions: how do we prioritize kernels for mixed-length sessions? e.g., convo starts short then goes long mid-stream.
leila: main concern is KV churn. if we switch kernels we might invalidate cached KV formats or sizes. need canonical KV serialization or migration strategy.
zoe-ml: agree with leila. propose a small compatibility shim: kernel exposes KV schema version; runtime refuses kernel switch mid-session unless schemas compatible. otherwise fallback to single-kernel path.
jon-eng: can we add a flag to force single-kernel for a request? we'll need that for some enterprise customers.
sam-pm: customer asks: "atlaspay" needs guaranteed p95 <= 200ms for 512-token inference. can we guarantee this if muxing picks the slower kernel sometimes? requirement: Dedicated customers can opt to pin kernel or set latency-first routing.
ana: yes — plan includes per-customer policy: {pin, prefer-latency, prefer-cost, balanced}. pin uses model+kernel pin. prefer-latency tries fastest kernel but with safety valve to avoid schema mismatch.
leila: about KV cold start: we should prewarm prefix caches for high-QPS tenants when enabling muxing. fallback if prewarm fails. also eviction heuristics must be stable under multiplexing.
matt: acceptance criteria draft: 1) correctness: no KV schema mismatches observed in canary; 2) latency: p95 <= target for latency-first customers during 1% canary; 3) stability: no >3x increase in cache miss rate for pinned tenants; 4) observability: dashboards + per-tenant breakdown.
zoe-ml: add quality guard: generation quality regression < 0.5% on evaluation prompts. muxing must not pick quantized kernels that degrade top-1 behavior on our eval set beyond that threshold.
rhea-sre: SRE asks: what alerts? recommend: kernel-switch-rate > 0.5%/min, KV-schema-error-rate > 0.01%, p95-token-latency increase > 20% vs baseline. also require tracing tags for kernel decisions.
ana: good call. I'll add alerts. rollout plan (proposal): 1) behind FF, 0% baseline; 2) internal dogfood 5% traffic for 48h; 3) 1% customer-facing canary for mixed customers (non-Dedicated) 72h; 4) expand to 10% with per-tenant opt-out allowed; 5) GA when metrics stable for 7 days.
sam-pm: for Dedicated customers, add "dry-run" mode where decision logs are recorded but not applied for 14 days so they can opt-in after validation. important for sales.
jon-eng: implementation note: add kernel_decision vector in trace:
```
kernel_decision: {chosen_kernel: "fast-attn-v2", reason: "latency", kv_schema: 3, fallback: null}
```
this will help with debugging.
leila: edge case: streaming + model-switch mid-stream. we should disallow kernel switches during streaming sessions. add to constraints.
zoe-ml: also handle long-context escalation: when seq_len > 4096, force the attention-optimized kernel even if cost higher. add override policy.
matt: cost control: add a monthly cap on extra-cost caused by muxing per-account. if exceeded, revert to cost-first policy automatically. needs billing integration.
rhea-sre: can we expose per-tenant cache-hit metric? that will be useful in alerts.
ana: yes, will require metrics team help.
deploy-bot: RFC draft uploaded to /rfcs/runtime/kernel-muxing (PR #842). Automated CI: perf tests queued. :package:
matt: quick perf ask: include synthetic burst test (10k reqs/min) and mixed-length traces (1-8k tokens). ensure eviction behavior observed.
zoe-ml: for evals, let's run the standard regression suite + a focused semantic test for quantized kernels. want to see hallucination / coherence deltas.
sam-pm: acceptance criteria checklist for PM side: 1) docs updated; 2) console flags for pinning + dry-run visible; 3) support playbook for customers who see regressions; 4) legal sign-off for Dedicated customers.
ana: open items I will action: - add KV schema compatibility checks - add per-tenant dry-run logging - add SRE alert thresholds - include billing cap proposal - prevent mid-stream and streaming kernel switches - add long-context override and edge-case list
leila: suggest we also add a small migration test harness to simulate KV migration between kernel versions. I can sketch one.
jon-eng: I'll own the trace field and FF wiring.
rhea-sre: SRE will own alerting and dashboard panels.
zoe-ml: ML will run the evals and quantify quality deltas.
sam-pm: PM will own customer comms and acceptance checklist.
nana: thanks all. I'll update RFC with these changes and ping for formal review next Wed. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: RFC PR #842: CI perf results: 95th latency on small-attn: 180ms, fast-attn-v2: 110ms, KV-schema-check tests: passing.
nana: noting that perf numbers look promising but we'll watch the canary for real traffic.
leila: tiny nit: add note about TLS and KMS behavior when pinning to private kernels for Private deployments.
nana: noted. adding to RFC.
sam-pm: thanks — moving to block reviewers: @matt, @leila, @zoe-ml, @rhea-sre. please review by Tue COB.
nana: end of thread.
